title: Alexander warns Harry; the sheriff and police over the stolen music
summary: Love tells Alexander to warn Harry, they settle with Lyons, and a sheriff and city police hear about the stolen music; they are told to finish the engagement.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I said, that's a nice fella. You know, I worked with Harry for years. I said, and Ellick was kind of scared. He said, well, before you get mad and I'm way up here, don't bring me home. I said, I'm the one that look out for you. Your daddy told me to look out for you. I said, you're not going with them fellas. And he fooled on. He said, well, you think I ought to tell Harry? I said, that's the thing you should do. Tell him. Tell him what them fellas is fixing to do. And I said, he said, well, I took $35 from him. They give me, give me mean wheat. They're going to take Harris. And I said, well, I took $35 from him. They give me dear know what it's all about you know. Take his saxophone player. Yeah he's gonna take his player. And he told me that you know I said well you go tell Harry this is what them boys gonna do. I said that's a nice fella. I said you might want to play with him again you know. And I said you going back to New Orleans. I said he's gonna take us back to New Orleans just like he come down there and got us. I said that's a gentleman. So Alexander told him you know and then I come up with him. I told Harry I said yeah you got a syndicate on there. You better look out for yourself you know. And Mr. Lyons he went back home to Chippewa Falls you know and he come pick the band up the next day. Harry said Mr. Lyons. He said I owe you about $15. I said there's your $15. I said now you owe for the gas this week. He said I'd like a settlement. Mr. Lyons said why you want a settlement? He said well that's the way I run business. I don't get my business right. I done paid my debt now I want you to pay me for the gas. Got the money for the gas and everything you know. So we so busy getting away from that town the highway we loaded up you know. And this Sunday kid done quit riding with us. He's riding Mr. Lyons in his car you know. Great big car. Harry said uh-huh I see what they're doing. So we lit out you know. So Harry said where's the music at? He said look here. I said we got to stop and get our music. That's it. I got too much music in there to lose. So Harry said I'm going to stop in this next town and get that music. So we when we got to that next town there was a sheriff there waiting for us. Waitin' for me, Harry, and the ship. And Wheat and Alexander. He was waitin' for us you know. He said of course I ain't got no charge against you. I can't arrest you boys but them fellas say y'all took their music you know. Y'all got the music. I said yeah then. I took it as my own property. They said they stole it from me and hid it on the mattress. He said I got the music back. He said well I'd like for y'all to drive to the curb Dan. He said you're not rustic or nothin' you can go on and eat some buckets or whatever you know. I told them fellas get Juddy right behind y'all they oughta be here in about a half an hour. So we waited man. Then the big thing come on and went over to the city hall. And Harry told the chief police you know all about it say. Well the fellas syndicated on me. He said we had a contract in Madison to play. He said but now I don't want none of it say. I've been a musician all my life. He said love yeah he's been with me. And Chip took love to play when love didn't play cornet the more I used ship on the bass. He said this fella young. I raised him in Alexander my saxophone player said they had him too. And he even bribed them. Give them $35. Told them if they didn't like the job they could come back on the cushions. He said now I don't want none of it and I'm gonna bring these boys back where I got them from. And Rock wanted to speak that Hebrew from Memphis. He said well Harry I don't want to go back down there no more. I'm stay back up north. You know I ain't going down there no more. Harry said I ain't got nothing to do with you at all. He said I'll come and got you in Memphis and I'll bring you back home if you want to go home. So if you want to stay up there with them you can go head on and stay but Alexander is going home with love. And Wheat I'll take care of him. Wheat cause I raised this boy. And he said shit don't want nothing to do with it. And he said I'm through. Harry said I can see you in the jail doors yearning for me. I'll quit. He said because I never been arrested in my life. Never been in no trouble. Never give nobody no trouble. And so the sheriff spoke you know. They said well I'll tell you what you do. Why don't you boys just go and finish that engagement and then quit after that and go home. dear
